testcase.system-out: Scenario: Launch a command by key tip from the minimized ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active ✔ When the user presses Alt ✔ Then top-level key tips appear ✔ When the user presses "M" ✔ Then the temporary 3D Model command area opens with command key tips ✔ And the Hole command displays the key tip "HO" ✔ When the user presses "H" ✔ Then the visible command key tips narrow to H-prefixed choices ✔ When the user presses "O" ✔ Then the Hole properties panel opens ✔ And the key tips disappear ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the Hole properties panel ✔ Then the properties panel closes ✔ And the temporary command area closes leaving the ribbon minimized to tabs ✔ When the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab ✔ Then the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
